scope_note: A dated research collection, not a live feed, polling average, forecast or election result. Only initial ballot preferences are compared. No parish or demographic allocation is made.
coverage_note: Three public general election surveys located in this review, from two polling firms. All three were commissioned by Jamie Davis's campaign. No independently sponsored Louisiana general election survey was located. This is a search finding, not proof that no other survey exists.

polls.mode: Landline, cell phone and text to web
polls.limitations: The memo does not provide the full questionnaire, full weighting details or complete tables. Its 502 interviews resolve a media report describing the sample as 500. The reported margin of error is not a win probability or an uncertainty interval for the difference between candidates.

polls.publication_basis: Date on original memo; linked news report published September 24
polls.mode: Landline, cell phone and text to web
polls.limitations: Only the initial ballot is charted. Results after candidate descriptions and results including initially undecided voters pressed for a preference are excluded. Full weighting details and complete tables are not supplied in the reviewed memo.

polls.publication_basis: Date of the source article, not the interview dates or a verified first release date

No margin of error or detailed weighting was supplied in the reviewed source. Registered voters and likely voters are different populations. Results after candidate descriptions are excluded.

national_context.mode: Text to web voter panel and additional online panel interviews
national_context.note: Rounded figures from the pollster release. Other responses are not charted and percentages are not rescaled. This is not a Louisiana poll or a Senate seat forecast.

national_context.sample_note: 1,289 registered voter interviews; displayed results use likely voter weights, not a separately reported likely voter interview count
national_context.uncertainty: Reported likely voter margin of error: ±3.8 percentage points
national_context.mode: Live phone interviews, text and online
